## AI Review Synthesis

<!-- sepo-agent-review-synthesis -->
<!-- sepo-agent-review-synthesis-head: dc984bc86ca4f42eba79f08863e8842b6d0f20db -->

> Dual-agent review by **Claude** and **Codex**.
> Requested by @lolipopshock.

## Summary of PR/Issue
PR #380 implements issue #375’s request to stop leaving Sepo’s model quality floor to ACPX/provider defaults. It adds small built-in provider defaults for Codex and Claude in `resolve-agent-provider`, preserves `AGENT_MODEL_POLICY` and inline route override precedence, and updates operator-facing docs. The linked issue asked for a minimal implementation: pin good defaults without turning Sepo into a full model catalog. The current implementation covers single-agent provider resolution and review synthesis, but not the direct Claude/Codex reviewer lanes.

## Review
The core resolver change is small and aligned with the requested minimal-defaults boundary. One unresolved gap remains: review lanes are still Sepo-owned default model runs, but they bypass the new pinned default path.

| Issue | Severity | Description |
| -- | -- | -- |
| Reviewer lanes remain on provider defaults | BLOCKING | `.github/workflows/agent-review.yml` still calls `run-agent-task` for Claude/Codex reviewer lanes without a `model`, while the new defaults only flow through `resolve-agent-provider`. This leaves a major Sepo-owned model path unpinned despite the PR’s goal. |

## Progress
- Resolver defaults now pin `codex` to `gpt-5.5` and `claude` to `claude-sonnet-4-6`.
- Existing policy and inline override precedence is preserved, and targeted resolver/docs coverage was added.
- Rubrics review passed and the alternate Claude review considered the remaining coverage/doc notes non-blocking.
- Posted one inline comment on `.agent/docs/customization/configuration-list.md` line 64 for the reviewer-lane gap.

## Issue Details

<details>
<summary>Reviewer lanes remain on provider defaults</summary>

**Cause:** The PR adds built-in defaults inside `resolve-agent-provider`, but the review matrix directly invokes `run-agent-task` with `agent: ${{ matrix.agent }}` and `reasoning_effort` only. The synthesis job uses the resolver, but the Claude/Codex reviewer jobs still rely on ACPX/provider defaults.

**Candidate solutions:** Add explicit model entries to the reviewer matrix and pass `model: ${{ matrix.model }}`, or run each reviewer lane through `resolve-agent-provider` with the provider fixed by the matrix lane so the same built-in defaults are applied.

**Comments:** Reviewers disagreed on severity: one review marked this blocking, while the Claude and rubrics reviews treated the PR as shippable. I’m treating it as blocking because issue #375 asked to pin good Sepo defaults, and these reviewer lanes are still default Sepo agent runs.

</details>

## Recommended Next Step
`FIX_PR`: The remaining issue is a concrete branch change suitable for automation: pin or resolver-derive models for the review lane matrix before the PR claims Sepo defaults are pinned.

## Final Verdict
NEEDS_REWORK

## Action Items
- [ ] Ensure the Claude and Codex reviewer lanes pass pinned model IDs, either via explicit matrix `model` values or by resolving each lane through `resolve-agent-provider` with the lane provider fixed.
